sourceSentences: Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to dash toward the target location, dealing magic damage to all enemies they pass through as well as those in front of them upon arrival, and slowing them by 25% for 1 second.

If there are multiple active Sand Soldiers, rather than all soldiers arriving at the target location they make a formation around it instead. If the number of soldiers is 2, then neither will arrive at the location.
Sand Soldiers will stop their movement upon colliding with Wind Wall or Rebuttal, but not Unbreakable.
If an enemy has sight of a Sand Soldier, they will also gain vision of Azir even if he is out of sight.
Azir grants himself a shield for 1.5 seconds and dashes to the Sand Soldier closest to the cursor, dealing magic damage to enemies within his path.
If Azir dashes into an enemy champion, he stops and gains a charge of Arise!
Azir can cast any of his abilities during the dash. Azir will track the Sand Soldier if they change locations, such as by Conquering Sands.

Upon finishing their charge, the soldiers stand as a wall for 5 seconds, acting as impassible terrain against enemies and granting sight of their surroundings. Azir and his allies can move through these soldiers.

All of the soldiers and their missiles will end the charge prematurely when one encounters Wind Wall / Unbreakable / Blade Whirl / Rebuttal or upon colliding with terrain that they cannot charge through.
While the soldiers are charging forward, the wall is not impassable terrain. This means enemies that are immune to airborne effects can pass through the wall while its moving.
The wall will count as terrain for the purposes of 'into terrain' effects (e.g. Condemn, Dredge Line, Heroic Charge).

the WQ flash R combo if you know that your opponent has flash using this combo will 100% guarantee that you knock them back towards your team you can also use this combo if you need some extra range to secure your r on a flashless Target
after alting azir's wall of soldiers will remain and allies can go through it while enemies can't this interaction is extremely useful for kiting
For combo: W, attack, W again and attack again. When the enemy moves, direct the soldiers with Q while continuing to attack
Your " Shurim Shuffle" is W , then E , and before reaching the soldier, use Q to get behind the enemy and use an ultimate that knocks the entire team in the other direction.
An interesting combo for entering battle: W, then E to the soldier, and then Q.
